title: Custom secret export options from scripted `EditorExportPlugin` reset when opening the project
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]
- Haven't tested, but probably also happens in current stable versions of v4.1 and v4.2.

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 18 Jan 2025 02:26:57 +0000 - Wayland - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (nvidia; 565.77) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600K (20 Threads)

### Issue description

When a secret property is added to export presets by a scripted `EditorExportPlugin`, its value is saved successfully at first. However, after the editor is closed and the project is opened again, the property's value is reset to the default value. At this point, the `.godot/export_credentials.cfg` file still contains the saved value. After the project is saved, the file resets to the default value.

Looking at [EditorExport::load_config()](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/71d80b26a4c47e1b5e1bab9ed8ef1512e359b5e9/editor/export/editor_export.cpp#L346), it seems like unrecognised secret options are reset on purpose. However, the options added by GDScript plugins are probably not present when that happens, resulting in the saved values being discarded.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a GDScript plugin that adds a secret export option. A sample code is provided below.
2. Open the project from the editor, and enable the plugin.
3. Create an export preset, change the value of the secret export option, and save the project.
4. Close the editor and re-open the project.
5. Check the option's value from the export window.

<details>

<summary>Sample plugin code</summary>

```gdscript
@tool
extends EditorPlugin


var _export_plugin: MyExportPlugin


func _enter_tree() -> void:
	_export_plugin = MyExportPlugin.new()
	add_export_plugin(_export_plugin)


func _exit_tree() -> void:
	remove_export_plugin(_export_plugin)
	_export_plugin = null


class MyExportPlugin extends EditorExportPlugin:
	const NORMAL_PROPERTY := "my_plugin/normal_property"
	const SECRET_PROPERTY := "my_plugin/secret_property"


	func _get_name() -> String:
		return "MyExportPlugin"


	func _supports_platform(_platform: EditorExportPlatform) -> bool:
		return true


	func _get_export_options(_platform: EditorExportPlatform) -> Array[Dictionary]:
		return [
			{
				"option": {
					"name": NORMAL_PROPERTY,
					"type": TYPE_STRING,
					"usage": PROPERTY_USAGE_DEFAULT,
				},
				"default_value": "",
			},
			{
				"option": {
					"name": SECRET_PROPERTY,
					"type": TYPE_STRING,
					"usage": PROPERTY_USAGE_DEFAULT | PROPERTY_USAGE_SECRET,
				},
				"default_value": "",
			},
		]


	func _get_export_option_warning(_platform: EditorExportPlatform, option: String) -> String:
		match option:
			NORMAL_PROPERTY, SECRET_PROPERTY:
				var value := get_option(option) as String
				return (
						"" if value
						else "Please change the property value and see if the change persists."
				)
			_:
				return ""
```

</details>

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The behaviour is reproducible in any new projects after following the instructions above.
